communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: SDI-HIDTA settlements and fiduciary agreements
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Background: Tommy LaNier and Valerie E. Taylor worked in the office of the San Diego-Imperial High Intensity Drug Trafficking Area (SDI-HIDTA). They each sued the City of Chula Vista related to their employment. Court filings state Mr. LaNier was on the City's payroll, and that the Chula Vista Police Department was a designated fiscal agent (fiduciary) for SDI-HIDTA.

1. Every settlement agreement, release, and stipulation resolving any claim by Mr. LaNier or Ms. Taylor against the City or any City officer or employee, with all attachments.
2. Every agreement, memorandum of understanding, grant award, or designation under which the City or the Chula Vista Police Department served as fiscal agent, fiduciary, or grantee for SDI-HIDTA or the California Border Alliance Group. This includes any terms on personnel, liability, indemnification, insurance, or legal defense.

The litigation has ended, so the pending-litigation exemption no longer applies. Settlement agreements of a public agency are public records. Copley Press, Inc. v. Superior Court, 63 Cal. App. 4th 367 (1998). If you withhold any record or part of one, please cite the exemption for each and release every reasonably segregable portion.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

HCvP

title: HIDTA Board Meeting Minutes and Annual Budget Requests

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: HIDTA Board Meeting Minutes and Annual Budget Requests
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

1.  The minutes of every meeting of the High Intensity Drug Trafficking Area (HIDTA) Executive Board for Houston HIDTA, Arizona HIDTA, ACHIDTA, and Midwest HIDTA that were provided to ONDCP from January 1, 2024 to the date of your search, with any attachments. Section 5.9 of ONDCP's HIDTA Program Policy and Budget Guidance (eff. Jan. 6, 2020) requires that "[m]inutes of each meeting must be prepared and provided to ONDCP."

2.  Each Annual Budget Request (ABR) submitted to ONDCP by or on behalf of the Houston HIDTA, Arizona HIDTA, ACHIDTA, or Midwest HIDTA executive boards, on or after January 1, 2024, with all of its parts and attachments. This includes the annual threat assessment, the strategy, each Initiative Description and Budget Proposal (IDBP), the Executive Board composition certification, and any record of the Executive Board's approval of the ABR. See Guidance §§ 2.4, 3.2.1, 5.2, 5.11.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

HCvP
